name: Coaching Calls
use: Zoom/Meet coaching calls for students and traders (camera tiles plus chart screen-shares) cut into many short clips

hook.hold: 4.5 s from the start, always under 5 s
hook.placement: by the first part: over the coach chest (camera), black band above the chart (chart split), over the student chest (student split)
hook.note: white caps on a red box per line, like the user's reference; never animated; short and plain
hook.copy: curiosity formulas: This is how / How a trader / Why you keep / Stop ... if / The real reason / Do this before; built from the student problem plus the payoff; see coaching-calls.md

camera.note: square crop of the speaker, full width

layout.split: chart parts and student-talking parts are split screen (top half 1080x960, coach fills the bottom half, no borders); coach-only camera parts stay a single full-width square
layout.safeZone: hook and captions above y 1530 and left of the right-edge button column

share.chartBand: chart fitted inside the top half, sitting on the seam
share.note: coach showing charts: chart on top, coach webcam fills the bottom half

student.note: student talking: student fills the top half, coach fills the bottom half

clips.pick: only the best teaching and inspirational moments, ranked with styles/coaching-calls/clip-selection-prompt.md
clips.hooks: the student's problem or question whenever possible
clips.arc: every clip holds the student problem and the coach solution, ending on the payoff

privacy.studentSurnames: blur (name tiles, camera labels, captions); first names and coaches stay
